summary: Improve your attention and focus skills with brain training games.
description:
We present this game collection to stimulate attention and to train concentration. Fun games to stimulate your brain in a playful way. This focus game is suitable for the whole family, from the youngest to the elderly and senior players.

TYPES OF GAMES

- Puzzles 
- Labyrinths
- Word Search
- Association of colors and words
- Find the differences
- Find objects
- Find the intruder

In addition to attention, these games help to stimulate other areas such as visual association, fine motor skills, visual memory or orientation.

APP FEATURES

Daily attention training
Available in 5 languages
Simple and intuitive interface
Different levels for all ages
Constant updates with new games

GAMES TO BOOST ATTENTION & FOCUS

Attention is one of the essential cognitive functions in our day to day life as the development of attention capacity helps to keep the mind healthy.

Attention refers to the ability to concentrate on a specific stimulus. It is a cognitive process that is in constant interaction with other domains such as memory.

This collection of puzzles is developed in collaboration with doctors and experts in neuropsychology. You will find games aimed at working the different types of attention:

Selective or focalized attention: Ability to attend to a stimulus ignoring the rest of irrelevant stimuli.
Divided or changing attention: ability to change the focus of attention from one task to another.
Sustained attention: ability to maintain concentration in a task for a certain time.

ABOUT TELLMEWOW

Tellmewow is a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability which makes our games ideal for the elderly or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.

If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay tuned about upcoming games, follow us on our social networks.
